result_contract.rule: Every result is explainable and source/owner traceable. incompatible identifies unsatisfied requirements; unresolved identifies missing/unknown authority; compatible_with_adapter identifies explicit adapter definitions still requiring owner-workflow acquisition/installation.

status_semantics.compatible: All blocking requirements are satisfied by current authoritative inputs. This grants no assignment or use authority by itself.
status_semantics.compatible_with_adapter: All blocking requirements are satisfiable only with one or more explicit adapter definitions. Adapter ownership/acquisition/installation is not implied.
status_semantics.incompatible: At least one blocking authoritative requirement is unsatisfied and no authorized adapter path in the evaluated input satisfies it.
status_semantics.unresolved: A required compatibility fact, relation, source decision or owner predicate is absent, unknown, conflicted or not authorized for evaluation.
